text:
matt: kicking off EU-Central-3 observability bring-up for the new GPU cluster — I need a quick checklist for logs/metrics/traces + cost guardrails, then handoff to oncall when smoke passes

jin: +1, main constraints: egress limits to our central Grafana, 10 Gbps peer cap, and nodepool AZ distribution. also need retention caps to keep costs sane

raja: for logs we'll run loki with micro-batching and 7d default retention. index_turn_down = true for dev namespaces. suggest tenant=eu-c3 for easier rollover

matt: can you paste the helm values you want for loki?

raja: sure, minimal snippet:
```yaml
loki:
  tenant: eu-c3
  retention_days: 7
  ingesters:
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 2Gi
  chunk_target_size: 1048576 # 1MB compress-friendly
  limits:
    max_streams_per_tenant: 5000
```

devon: for metrics we'll push Prometheus remote_write to a dedupe cluster (prom-remote-eu). need relabel configs to drop high-cardinality labels (pod_ip, container_id)

jin: also add service-level sampling on traces (Tempo). 10% default sampling for infer jobs, 100% for api-gateway traces until the first week

oncall-sre: what are the smoke success criteria?

matt: smoke checklist idea:
- logs: can ingest 100 rps without dropping -> check via "lokictl ingest-stress"
- metrics: 3s scrape, no >5s scrape errors for 5m
- traces: end-to-end latency spans visible in Grafana -> query by trace_id from test harness
- dashboards: node/gpu/disk/ingest dashboards populated
- alerts: cpu/mem/gpu temp alerts firing in test sim
- cost guardrails: alert when daily ingest > 1.2x baseline or when egress > 80% of peer cap

infra-bot: ran terraform plan for eu-c3-observability, outputs: peering_id=pcx-0a1b2c3d, nat_gateways=2, k8s_ingress_ip=34.78.123.45

raja: reminder: set Loki tenant limits to avoid noisy-namespace storms. add a quota per-namespace: 200 MB/day default, escalate via request ticket

devon: dashboard provisioning: use Grafonnet snapshot publish job. job name: grafana-sync-euc3, run once after helm apply

jin: alert templates (examples):
```yaml
- alert: LokiIngestSpike
  expr: sum(rate(loki_ingester_received_bytes_total[5m])) by (job) > 1e9
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: Loki ingest spike in {{ $labels.job }}
- alert: PrometheusScrapeFailures
  expr: sum(prometheus_scrape_duration_seconds_count{job=~"kube-.*"} - prometheus_scrape_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"kube-.*"}) > 0
  for: 5m
```

matt: good. devon can you add the relabel rules and the grafana-sync job to the kustomize overlay and push to infra repo? tag me when done

devon: on it, will push a branch in 15m. ETA for helm apply after approvals ~ 2h

oncall-sre: I'll run the smoke harness after the branch is merged. what's the expected rollout strategy? canary?

matt: canary 10% of cluster nodes for first 2 hours, then 50% if no alerts, full at 24h. fallback: point remote_write to warm standby in eu-west1 if egress limit hit

raja: cost controls: set byte_ingest_metric with alert and daily budget notification to the billing slack channel, and set a rate limit at the loki gateway (200 MB/s per tenant burst)

jin: networking gotcha — cloud provider enforces 5k reserved ephemeral ports per VPC peering. need to test intensity of gRPC streams for prom remote_write, consider multiplexing

matt: final handoff steps for oncall-sre:
1) confirm peering and k8s networkpolicy applied
2) run loki ingest-stress and prometheus-scrape stress tests
3) validate dashboards and alert firing using test tags
4) escalate to infra oncall if egress > 80% of pcx cap (pcx-0a1b2c3d)
5) open cost ticket if daily ingest > baseline * 1.2

oncall-sre: received. will start after merge and post results here. :white_check_mark:

matt: thanks all — tag me with the branch and I'll do the approvals. leaving the thread open for logs from smoke run
